notes: Produced a balanced initial controller with moderate PID gains and sensor weights matching sensor layout, expecting stable line following and moderate speed.
rationale: The initial geometry is balanced with 5 medium-sized sensors evenly spread across the front, a moderate wheel track and radius, and a compact body for stability and control. To complement this, I designed a PID controller with moderate gains to provide stable line following and smooth steering. Sensor weights are set to create a gradient from left to right sensors, enabling the controller to detect line position and steer accordingly. The base speed is set moderately to allow completion with control, and line loss behavior is set to 'search_left' to recover from line loss by steering right. The observation request includes completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and completion_time to evaluate performance and guide future tuning.
